title: Anonymous official campus map entry
read_scope: The entry page exposed 2D, 3D, imagery, search, layer and label modes; the author did not obtain the complete map data.
problem: One official entry may serve several expression and information roles; those roles cannot become one geometric truth.
project_rule: Register each mode/layer separately. Source identity, schematic layout and geographic base independently; Q02 and Q13.
workflow_change: Identify the exact layer and source role before attributing an object property to it.
limitations: The actual map engine was not operated and site geometry was not downloaded. Page functionality does not prove a particular footprint. The original institutional name, URL, site identifier and coordinates are excluded; no replacement campus evidence is asserted.
edition_note: Original identity and locator excluded; technical lesson retained without replacement evidence.

title: Anonymized provider A coordinate-conversion documentation
read_scope: Accepted input reference types, reference-selector parameter, longitude/latitude order and documented output behavior.
problem: Interfaces have different input references and defaults. Missing or repeated conversion can both cause displacement.
project_rule: Record each input reference, conversion direction, implementation and output; Q02.
workflow_change: Inspect actual calls and conversion count instead of inferring coordinates from a brand or variable name.
limitations: A documented direction is not authorization or an accuracy guarantee for arbitrary bidirectional conversion. Original provider identity, regional reference names and URL are excluded, with their technical lesson retained.
edition_note: Original identity and locator excluded; technical lesson retained without replacement evidence.

title: Anonymized provider B coordinate-reference documentation
read_scope: Differences between global geographic coordinates and the provider-specific geographic and projected product formats.
problem: Mixing products or treating longitude/latitude and a projected numeric space as interchangeable corrupts coordinates.
project_rule: Record reference, units and axis order per product/interface, never at brand level; Q02.
workflow_change: Inspect each input field and distinguish geographic from projected provider outputs.
limitations: The original provider identity, regional reference names and URL are excluded. This historical record does not establish a current Anima provider or authorized conversion.
edition_note: Original identity and locator excluded; technical lesson retained without replacement evidence.

title: QGIS 3.44: Georeferencer
read_scope: Ground-control-point storage, transformation families, outputs and residual reports, including high-order and thin-plate-spline distortion risks.
problem: A perfect control-point fit can conceal local distortion and extrapolation.
project_rule: Save points/model and compare simple to complex models. The project additionally requires independent points; Q03.
workflow_change: Report fit and independent error separately instead of stretching every point into apparent agreement.
limitations: Independent holdouts and frozen thresholds are the package author’s project design, not claimed quotations of the documentation.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: IETF RFC 7946: GeoJSON
read_scope: Coordinate system, Polygon ring structure/orientation and compatibility provisions.
problem: Arbitrary projected XY JSON is mislabeled standard GeoJSON, or winding is confused with all geometry validity.
project_rule: Declare interchange semantics, check geographic axes/units, and distinguish normalization from compatibility; Q02 and Q05.
workflow_change: Validate the actual imported format rather than inferring coordinate correctness from a file extension.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: PROJ: Web Mercator
read_scope: Web Mercator computation and spherical approximation.
problem: Display projection units or pixels are treated as physical road meters.
project_rule: Use appropriate measured coordinates or reliable surface geodesy for real dimensions; Q02 and Q07.
workflow_change: Store physical measured width and render width separately rather than measuring reality from a screenshot.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: NGA Hootenanny
read_scope: README descriptions of automatic/semi-automatic conflation, human treatment of uncertain matches and feature-class capabilities.
problem: Stacking sources is mistaken for fusion, producing duplicates and opaque choices.
project_rule: Match entities before deciding attributes; preserve one-to-many/many-to-one mappings and unresolved correspondences; Q01 and Q13.
workflow_change: Match semantics and decide candidates instead of averaging conflicting coordinates.
limitations: The method is relevant; installing the entire platform is not required.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: PostGIS ST_IsValidDetail
read_scope: The valid/reason/location result and rule differences.
problem: A bare failure does not reveal where the geometry is wrong.
project_rule: Return entity ID, error type and witness position from geometric operations; Q04.
workflow_change: Use existing geometry capability for locatable faults instead of checks that merely assert a function exists.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: PostGIS ST_MakeValid
read_scope: Linework/structure strategies and the possibility of changed type, splitting or dimensional collapse.
problem: Automatic formal repair can destroy a real contour, courtyard or neighborhood.
project_rule: Compare area, components, holes, type and relations before/after repair; Q04, Q06 and Q13.
workflow_change: Do not run unsupervised whole-map make-valid and call it factual correctness.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: OpenStreetMap: Key:layer
read_scope: Relative vertical relationships, crossings, shared nodes and warnings against using layer to mask overlap.
problem: Every planar crossing is rejected, or a layer flag hides a real conflict.
project_rule: Separate relative level, measured elevation and render order. Evidence exceptions; Q10 and Q11.
workflow_change: Resolve bridge, tunnel, passage or elevated relations before connectivity and penetration judgment.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: OpenStreetMap: Key:width
read_scope: Physical width, default units, source:width, estimated width and the distinction from a width restriction.
problem: Physical, restricted, estimated and screen-outline widths are mixed.
project_rule: Keep definition, source and estimate status; inspect continuity through supported events; Q07 and Q08.
workflow_change: Exclude casing/cap faults before changing a centerline or physical width.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: OpenStreetMap: Simple 3D Buildings
read_scope: Outline versus building:part, height/min_height, overhanging and underground part relationships.
problem: Parent and parts are double-extruded, base/top height are confused or upper projection becomes grounded footprint.
project_rule: Parts need membership and vertical intervals; inspect duplicate massing; Q14 and Q15.
workflow_change: Audit the generator and part evidence before adding individual building detail.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: OGC CityGML official overview
read_scope: City-object semantics, geometry, relationships, multilevel representation and separation of encoding in the official overview.
problem: A 3D model is reduced to meshes without stable entities or relations.
project_rule: Separate semantics/representation and evidence band/display LOD; Q13–Q17.
workflow_change: Store building composition and connection facts rather than substituting mesh complexity for evidence.
limitations: Only the overview was read. The large complete standard did not open; no whole-standard interpretation or conformity certification is claimed.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: CesiumGS 3D Tiles specification
read_scope: Hierarchical LOD, geometricError, screen-space error and ADD/REPLACE refinement.
problem: A display approximation error is called real-world accuracy, or parent/child double rendering causes ghosts.
project_rule: Separate display error from geographic truth and inspect cracks, duplicates and flashes; Q22.
workflow_change: Use hierarchy only if the actual engine and scale need it, not to introduce another named engine.
limitations: Geometric error concerns approximation of the source model, not a measured site survey error.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: TU Delft 3dfier
read_scope: Rule-based reconstruction from 2D GIS, feature classes and point-cloud heights, including adjacent-feature integration.
problem: All polygons are arbitrarily raised with no coordinated ground/mass model.
project_rule: Reconstruction needs height inputs, class rules and boundary review; Q15 and Q17.
workflow_change: Reconstruct by class only with actual reliable height data; do not imagine a point cloud.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: Ledoux 2018: val3dity paper
read_scope: 3D GIS primitives, validity, validation and error cases; the historical author inspected figures on PDF pages 3 and 10.
problem: 2D validity is mistaken for 3D validity, while some faults are hidden in normal views.
project_rule: Check shells/faces/solids according to declared representation and keep factual review separate; Q16.
workflow_change: Locate precise errors for review without claiming validator success proves reality.
limitations: DOI 10.1186/s40965-018-0043-x. This does not establish which 3D format the actual project uses.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: val3dity 2.2.0 error taxonomy
read_scope: Ring, polygon, shell, solid and collection errors, format differences and tolerance.
problem: One rule is imposed on every mesh, rejecting legitimate open surfaces or missing solid faults.
project_rule: Applicability depends on declared Solid/MultiSurface and related representation; Q16.
workflow_change: Report type, threshold and error position; not every visible surface must be watertight.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: OpenStreetMap: leisure=track
read_scope: Linear/area track representation, running ring versus infield, and area/road semantics.
problem: A track becomes an arbitrary ellipse or is confused with its surrounding road.
project_rule: Model ring, infield, markings and supporting facilities separately under shared rules; Q18.
workflow_change: Review comparable tracks with common rules while sourcing per-facility differences.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: OpenStreetMap: leisure=pitch
read_scope: Playing surfaces, sport/surface, facility assemblies, multi-use sites and unknown extents.
problem: Incorrect sport, count, dimensions and ancillary boundaries are duplicated.
project_rule: Match court type, direction, count and surface to its parameterized rule; Q18.
workflow_change: Identify actual facility composition before drawing lines; do not apply basketball markings to every surface.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: 2026 ITF Rules of Tennis
read_scope: Rule 1 and the court appendix; the historical author actually viewed the court diagram on PDF page 36.
problem: Markings are drawn freehand without distinguishing playing area from surrounding space.
project_rule: Standard parameters supply a template and plausibility check; actual site compliance needs evidence; Q18.
workflow_change: Derive reviewable markings from parameters rather than use an attractive image as dimension proof.
limitations: No actual site courts were measured. The rules cannot establish that a particular facility obeys those dimensions.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: OpenStreetMap: natural=water
read_scope: Water types, natural/artificial distinction, linear channels, islands and holes.
problem: Channel, water surface, bridge and other muted surfaces lose their meanings.
project_rule: Separate surface, bank, centerline and bridge, and represent islands by valid relationships; Q19.
workflow_change: Trace every supplemental crossing line to an entity class instead of coloring it as generic technical decoration.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: MapLibre Style Specification: Layers
read_scope: Line width, cap/join, symbol priority, zoom and layer properties.
problem: Physical/pixel width, junction seams and label hierarchy become confused.
project_rule: Separate facts from screen style; use shared tokens and scale bands; Q08 and Q20–Q22.
workflow_change: Find equivalent properties in the actual engine and fix display mechanisms without moving facts.
limitations: The original project stack was not supplied. MapLibre is a method reference, not a confirmed dependency.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: Mapbox: Optimize map label placement
read_scope: Collision, variable anchors, density and drawing priority.
problem: Every label appears at once or all labels are suppressed to evade conflict.
project_rule: Review anchors, category priority, scale filtering and reachable identity together; Q21.
workflow_change: Inspect actual projected text/control boxes rather than only DOM text existence.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: Esri: Primary design principles for cartography
read_scope: Legibility, contrast, figure/ground, hierarchy and proportion.
problem: Dark technical style becomes an excuse for semantically unreadable low contrast.
project_rule: Preserve the warm dark direction while organizing luminance, texture and edges by feature/task; Q20 and Q21.
workflow_change: Review finished rendering; identical pixel colors are not the definition of consistent style.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: PostGIS ST_CoverageSimplify
read_scope: Topology-preserving shared-edge simplification and its valid-coverage prerequisites.
problem: Independent simplification of neighboring polygons creates gaps or overlaps.
project_rule: Generalization is derived display; simplify shared edges together and retain semantic nodes; Q22.
workflow_change: Scale organization cannot overwrite and damage canonical geometry.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: OpenStreetMap Copyright and License
read_scope: ODbL, attribution and data sharing conditions.
problem: OSM is treated as unconditional content or software/data licenses are confused.
project_rule: Record data derivation, attribution and applicable rights separately from code; Q25.
workflow_change: Identify distributable asset classes rather than treating a code license as map-data permission.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: OSMF Tile Usage Policy
read_scope: Public tile caching, attribution and restrictions on bulk downloading/offline prefetch.
problem: Whole-map automated review can unintentionally scrape a public service.
project_rule: Use lawfully obtained self-generated/offline data for full-area work, not a public tile sweep; Q25.
workflow_change: Review network use by checking tools against service/resource boundaries too.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: Anonymized provider A service terms
read_scope: Restrictions on extraction, copying, caching, adaptation, derived data and display.
problem: Withholding original imagery is treated as permission to extract or recreate restricted data.
project_rule: Record allowed uses from actual authorization. Manual reference is not an automatic exemption; Q25.
workflow_change: Keep unresolved restricted geometry out of delivery and seek lawful evidence.
limitations: This was an engineering reading of historical terms, not a complete legal opinion; a specific contract can differ. Original regional provider identity and URL are excluded.
edition_note: Original identity and locator excluded; technical lesson retained without replacement evidence.

title: Anonymized provider B service terms
read_scope: Extraction, caching, screenshots, derived databases and attribution requirements.
problem: Public visibility is mistaken for permission to cache, trace or publish.
project_rule: Record exact product, terms, intended use and actual authorization; Q25.
workflow_change: Do not copy geometry from a reference screenshot to evade a restriction.
limitations: Applicability depends on actual product/contract, not one blanket judgment. Original regional provider identity and URL are excluded.
edition_note: Original identity and locator excluded; technical lesson retained without replacement evidence.

title: Google Maps Platform Terms
read_scope: Section 3.2.3 restrictions on scraping, unlicensed caching and specified derivative-content examples.
problem: Manual building tracing while withholding Google imagery can still be restricted.
project_rule: Check actual authorization before tracing roads/contours from satellite content; Q25.
workflow_change: Do not assume imagery can become an owned independent vector database.
limitations: Evaluate actual product, special terms and authorization. This is a historical reading, not a current legal determination.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: Google Maps / Google Earth Additional Terms
read_scope: Content use, copying, bulk acquisition and reconstruction restrictions.
problem: Ordinary end-product permissions are confused with Platform API permissions.
project_rule: Record specific product rather than only provider name; Q25.
workflow_change: Identify the service before deciding whether content may be saved, compared or transformed into data.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: Git: git-worktree
read_scope: Independent working directories, shared repository, branch occupancy and worktree management.
problem: Concurrent writers edit the same directory and overwrite one another.
project_rule: Bind genuine isolated write assignments to baseline commits and one writer per file; Q24.
workflow_change: Make parallelism real through ownership and mergeable work rather than multiple writers in one file.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.

title: OpenAI: Worktrees
read_scope: Project chat/worktree isolation, starting branches, detached HEAD and handoff.
problem: Independent project chats and subagents are conflated, and every client is assumed able to start them automatically.
project_rule: Check actual capability, directory and commit; truthful read-only or serial alternatives apply when unavailable; Q24.
workflow_change: Bind responsibility contracts to actual sessions/paths/commits. Scoped MERGE_READY is not full-map acceptance. Current team governance replaces the source’s historical subagent restriction.
limitations: The reading did not establish that a particular client exposed a goal command or that the author could open local sessions. This edition does not claim a fresh product-documentation check.
edition_note: Historical research record; no later source recheck is claimed.
